projects.name: Project
details: AI-Powered Urban Grievance System Jan 2024 - Present
• Developing an AI -driven Grievance Management System for Indian Smart Cities, leveraging GenAI (OpenAI,
LLaMA3), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and BERT models. The system captures citizens’
problems  from  a vast  corpus  of social  media  and  RSS feed  data,  enabling  city  operators  to proactively  address
issues, enhance city maintenance, and improve safety

projects.name: Project
details: SNS Analysis Tool, ICCC Apr 2023 - Feb 2024

analysis  and  grievance  classification.  This  tool  empowers  authorities  to efficiently  address  citizen  concerns  on
platforms like Twitter.
